info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Telecom Sim Status-v2-spec
info.description: The Telecom SIM Status Retrieval API allows users to fetch real-time status information for telecommunications SIM cards. This endpoint provides insights into various state parameters of SIMs, facilitating operational monitoring and management. Typical consumers include network administrators and service management teams who need to ensure the optimal functioning of SIM assets. By leveraging this API, users can efficiently track and manage SIM statuses to enhance service reliability.

get.summary: Retrieve the current status of the SIM.
get.description: This endpoint allows developers to retrieve the current operational status of the SIM. It provides detailed information regarding connectivity, validity, and any errors that may be affecting the SIM's performance.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving the status of the SIM. This body specifies the parameters necessary for the operation to return the current SIM status.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the current status.
